origin.description: Reads an SPSS .por file into a tibble.
origin.usage: read_por(file, user_na = FALSE, col_select = NULL, skip = 0, n_max = Inf, .name_repair = "unique")

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A path or the raw bytes of the file.

arguments.name: user_na
arguments.text: When true, SPSS user missings stay as values on a labelled_spss column.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

origin.details: The arguments match read_sav. There is no encoding argument; the portable format declares its own.

translation.description: Reads an SPSS .por file into a tibble.
translation.usage: read_por(file, user_na=False, col_select=None, skip=0, n_max=float("inf"), name_repair="unique")

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A path or the raw bytes of the file.

arguments.name: user_na
arguments.text: When true, SPSS user missings stay as values on a labelled_spss column.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

translation.details: The arguments match read_sav. There is no encoding argument; the portable format declares its own.
translation.example:
from haven import read_por
d = read_por("/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/haven/proof/fixtures/sample.por")
print(d.names, d.columns[0].values)
